answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 15811 Country: AF Title: Hezbollah Kandahar, Afghantian I am working as reporter (admin and finance) in a company the donor give fund to a company but the owner of the company steal(Chori) money from the fund and I am making wrong report to donor so how is my work and how is my salary should I leave my work or not ? Question: Hezbollah Kandahar, Afghantian I am working as reporter (admin and finance) in a company the donor give fund to a company but the owner of the company steal(Chori) money from the fund and I am making wrong report to donor so how is my work and how is my salary should I leave my work or not ? Answer ID: 15811 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1531/1451=B=1430) As telling lie is sin, writing lie is also sin, and the income earned out of haram work is not pure. It is advisable to look for any other job and leave this one. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
